According to `r xf("sec-intro-to-functions")`, what is the definition of a mathematical function?

```{mcq}
#| label: tlw-1-dkw
1.  A mathematical concept that converts units associated with quantities.
1.  A mathematical concept that connects an unknown variable to a desired solution.
1.  A mechanism that transforms one or more inputs into a corresponding output. [correct]
1.  A mechanism that transforms one or more inputs into a collection of outputs.
1.  A graph that passes the horizontal line test.
1.  A graph that has a horizontal and vertical axis.
```

:::
